description: Source code for CoreDataflowNodeProcessor class and FlowResolver class, responsible for analyzing and resolving nodes in a data flow graph within Apache Spark SQL pipelines, including handling unresolved flows, topological sorting, and exception handling.

classes.name: CoreDataflowNodeProcessor
classes.description: Processor class for analyzing and topologically sorting nodes in a data flow graph, resolving flows, and handling different node types such as tables, views, and sinks.

classes.name: FlowResolver
classes.description: Helper class for resolving individual flows within the data flow graph, managing flow configurations, handling success and failure cases, and converting unresolved flows into resolved flows.

methods.name: processUnresolvedFlow
methods.description: Resolves an unresolved flow and adds it to the queue and map for topological processing.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a graph node, resolving flows, virtualizing tables, and handling views and sinks.

methods.name: attemptResolveFlow
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a flow using available inputs and configuration, handling success, duplicate configs, and exceptions.

methods.name: convertResolvedToTypedFlow
methods.description: Converts a flow into a specific resolved flow type based on its properties, such as streaming or once-only.
